column1: # The Vengeful Wraith: Golden Sun: Dark Dawn's Karis, thirty years on, met in
# the Umbral Rift's Ritual Room (enemy row 166; her name, longer than a unit's
# 14 letters, is shown from this message in battle: BattleUnit_Set,
# window/window/decode.c, window/screens/targets.c). She holds the party in
# contempt and is cold to Ivan above all, speaking in riddles, as if she were
# the one he could not save (UmbralRift_SeeRitual, UmbralRift_KarisAftermath

column3: Too late? I've never\nseen you before.{end_wait}
Not yet, you haven't.{page_break}You'll reach for me,\nand close your hand\non nothing.{end_wait}
...Strange. I came here\nhating you.{page_break}It was good to see\nyou. One last time.{end_wait}
She looked at me like\nshe knew me...{end_wait}
Who are you? How did\nyou get in here?{end_wait}
I don't know why\nI'm here. Or how.{page_break}But I know you.\nThat's enough.{end_wait}
Whoever she was, she\nwasn't from here.{end_wait}
